linear_fem.caption: All six Tet4/Hex8 objects falling and deforming against the floor; default physics and resolution.

linear_fem_baymax_cut.caption: Six finite slices produce ten disconnected material pieces; the clip then hides the skin and switches to an elevated, colored connectivity debug view.

diffsim_bear.caption: Fresh live inference after one Adam update, using all 1,986 vertices, 5,354 tetrahedra and 80 substeps per frame.

fem_phantom_regions.caption: Click the 2D pad map to select a SutureBot wound: right-drag wound 4, switch to wound 6, disable FEM, then return to wound 4. Wound numbers follow the dataset; inactive material stays fixed.

fem_suturebot.caption: Replay the tissue3 needle-throw recording with prepared USD tools, cameras and the original phantom. Four synchronized views compare the model with source video; green point labels stay on the mesh. Each fresh jaw closure can translate the free rigid needle to the gripper again, preserving its orientation, then hold it until release into MuJoCo dynamics. This is replay assistance; camera and needle placement remain estimates, and tissue puncture is not simulated.
